title: The url identity helper does not normalise // and dot segments or a trailing-dot host, and reads x, x.git and x/.git as one repository
goal: kbpublic.location normalises a remote url's repository path (repeated slashes, . and .. segments, a trailing-dot host, a doubled .git) and resolves a local path in git's own lookup order (x, then x.git, then x/.git), so the same repository is matched and two different repositories at x and x.git are not

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic;a=kbpublic.location('https://example.com/org//repo','.');b=kbpublic.location('https://example.com/org/repo','.');ok=kbpublic.same_repository(a,b);print('double slash matched:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
